definitions.explanation: first of all; before anything else; right away

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きたら→起きる：00521_okiru⟧{真|ま}っ{先|さき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}して→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please contact us first if any problem occurs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{顧|かえり}み→顧みる：30613_kaerimiru⟧ず{真|ま}っ{先|さき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飛|と}び{込|こ}んで→飛び込む：04614_tobikomu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{助|たす}けた→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧。
examples.english: She jumped in first without regard for danger and rescued the person.

notes:
{真|ま}っ{先|さき} combines the intensifying prefix {真|ま}っ with ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (ahead, first), meaning "the very first" or "before anyone/anything else."

Usage patterns:
- {真|ま}っ{先|さき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (adverbially: first, before others)

Often used to emphasize being the first to do something, particularly when volunteering or responding quickly.

Related {真|ま}っ~ words:
- ⟦{真|ま}っ{白|しろ}→真っ白：07613_masshiro⟧ (pure white)
- ⟦{真|ま}っ{暗|くら}→真っ暗：07616_makkura⟧ (pitch dark)
- ⟦{真|ま}っ{赤|か}→真っ赤：03734_makka⟧ (bright red)
